about_short_description.short_description: Orbital Therapeutics is a biotechnology company that develops RNA-based medicines to treat disease in humans.

product.name: RNA Medicines Platform
product.description: A technology-agnostic platform for designing RNA-based therapeutics tailored to specific disease biology, optimizing expression, duration, and tissue targeting.

product.name: Immunomodulation RNA Therapeutics
product.description: RNA-based treatments designed to modulate the immune system for autoimmune diseases and oncology by in vivo expression of CARs and immunomodulatory proteins.

product.name: Next-Generation mRNA Vaccines
product.description: RNA vaccines designed to improve upon existing mRNA vaccines by enabling combination, heterologous prime-boost, and polyfunctional vaccine strategies.

product.name: Protein Therapeutics via RNA Medicines
product.description: RNA-based therapeutics that enable the expression of therapeutic proteins to treat genetic protein deficiencies and other conditions.
